## 

```{r}
#| echo: False
library(tidyverse)
library(bnlearn)
library(mgcv)


```

```{r}

data = read_csv("data/ckd.csv")
head(data)
```

```{r}
data = data|>
  select(sod, bp, sc)


clean_data = na.omit(data)
clean_data

```

```{r}
dag =model2network("[sc|bp][sod][bp|sod]")
```

```{r}
graphviz.plot(dag, shape = "ellipse")
```

```{r}
ckd_fit = bn.fit(dag, data=data)
ckd_fit$bp
ckd_fit$sc
```

```{r}
##Esto efectivamente coincide con lo de arriba intercept:104.9604284   pot:0.3689704  sod:-0.2220313 
mod_lm = lm(bp ~ sod, data = data)
coef(mod_lm)

```

```{r}
install.packages("mgcv")

```

```{r}
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)

```

```{r}
##gam(hijo ~ padres)
mod_gam_bp = gam(bp ~ s(sod), data = data, method = "REML")

mod_gam_sc = gam(sc ~ s(bp), data = data, method = "REML")

plot(mod_gam_bp, residuals = TRUE, shade = TRUE)
plot(mod_gam_sc, residuals = TRUE, shade = TRUE)

```

```{r}
mod_sod = lm(sod~1, data = clean_data)
mod_gam_bp = gam(bp ~ s(sod), data = clean_data)
mod_gam_sc = gam(sc ~ s(bp, k = 1), data = clean_data)

-1/2*(BIC(mod_sod)+BIC(mod_gam_bp)+BIC(mod_gam_sc))
```

```{r}
#BIC
score(dag, data = clean_data, type = "bic-g")

```
